name: structure-viewer
description: Open XYZ and extxyz atomic structures directly in the Codex side panel, scrub trajectories, and edit files.

interface.shortDescription: 原子结构与轨迹查看、编辑
interface.longDescription: Click an extxyz or xyz file to open an interactive atomic structure editor with a bottom frame slider. Includes VASP-format viewing for files with .poscar, .contcar, .vasp or .xdatcar extensions.
